full_page.content:
c. 1900 - 1908
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK No. 9
Pg. 38 Fr. Robert's Lenten Sermons
1908
God the Creator
1. "The fool hath said in his heart there is no God Psalm XIII, 1
2. I am the Way -T. - L. John XIV, 6.
3. He was wounded for our iniquities. He was bruised for our sins. The chas- tisment of our peace was laid upon Him and by His wounds we are healed. And you when you were dead in your sins, He hath quickened, blotting out the hand- writing of the decree which was against us, fastening to the Cross.
4. "Whose sins you shall forgive They are forgiven them." John XXI
5. "He that eateth my flesh and drinketh my blood hath everlasting life, and I will raise him up at the last day." John VI, 55.
Pg. 39 Oct. 17, 1900 (ab imo pectore suspirans) Admirans amabilitatem et pulcharetudinem humilitatis quaerensque eius laudem in
dictibus sanctorum et non invenire potui mihi in mentem venit, dum gemui,
"Mitis sum et humilis corde" - Discite a me.
F. Virginitatis III Sund in Oct. Albitas regionum Joan. IV, 35. Humilitas et instrumentum metere etiam.
Resolutions Retr. 1903
I. Will abstain from eating before receiving coffee soup or tea, resp. II. Will make an end of eating at 1 S.
1 W. 37 St. 460 W. 44th
END OF NOTEBOOK NO. 9
